feature: Customer Portal v2 -- Operate -> Policy Decisions (/portal-v2/policy-decisions), WIRED TO REAL DATA. The page previously rendered the design fixture POLICY_DECISIONS; it now renders the calling customer's own documented positions from msp_risk_decisions via GET /api/portal/policy-decisions -- the same table and the same customer-scoped route file as the Risk Register, filtered to rows that carry a decision_state. Structural copy assertions (heading, standfirst, the four-state counter row, the knowledge-base note) are unchanged because that copy is the design's and did not move.
notes: WHAT CHANGED. The previous version asserted the FIXTURE's decisions (CMP-A1, CMP-A2 and their counts). The page now reads the customer's real register, so those ids no longer exist for any real tenant and asserting them would guarantee a red run. The fixture-side derivations they used to pin are still pinned by src/components/portal-v2/policyDecisionsModel.test.ts, which runs over POLICY_DECISIONS on purpose.

ONE ROUTE FILE, TWO PAGES. Policy Decisions and the Risk Register are two views of ONE table -- the design itself says so: fixture risk RSK-007 and fixture decision CMP-A1 carry the SAME register reference, RR-2026-011, because a documented policy position IS an accepted risk. So artifacts/api-server/src/routes/portal-risk-register.ts serves both, and this page's rows are the register's rows filtered to those with a decision_state.

THE NUMBERS BELOW COME FROM SEEDED ROWS, STATED PLAINLY. lib/db/migrations/manual/2026-08-21-portal-v2-risk-register-testbed-seed.sql seeds four rows against msp_id 1 + tenant c4c814d4-3afe-441e-9145-62461d0a4fd3 (the tenant behind TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL); TWO of them carry decision_state='live' and therefore appear here: RBD-2026-102 (Audit log retention, RR-2026-014) and RBD-2026-104 (Teams chat retention, RR-2026-011). The read path and scoping are real; the row content is seeded demonstration data.

EXPECTED COUNTERS: live 2, proposed 0, due 0, expired 0. A row with an unrecognised decision_state falls back to 'proposed' rather than being dropped -- hiding a real decision because of a bad enum value is worse than showing it in the lane that claims least.

THE LOGIN BLOCK IS NOT OPTIONAL. /portal-v2/* sits behind ProtectedRoute. On a WebView2 that is already authenticated the two `input` steps fail while the rest runs green -- a known harness artefact, not a page fault.

UI ROUTE SHAPE: msp-portal's outer WouterRouter has base '/portal' and SlugScope nests a second router at '/{slug}', so the real URL is /portal/{slug}/portal-v2/policy-decisions. App.tsx declares it BEFORE '/portal-v2/:pillar' so the param route does not swallow it.
ROLE FLOOR IS CustomerUser. TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL (shanemccaw+buyassessment@outlook.com) is a real CustomerUser, verified against the users/tenants join.
shaneapp://runTest hits the DEPLOYED build, not the local worktree.
ENV VARS required: DEPLOY_URL, TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL / TEST_PORTAL_PASSWORD, TEST_PORTAL_SLUG.

A1 -- the customer-scoped policy-decisions endpoint answers with an array. This endpoint did not exist before this build.
A2 -- extract the FIRST decision's title off the wire. PD9 asserts this exact string reaches the DOM, which is the real API-to-DOM integration proof.
A3 -- ...and its register reference, which is the join between this page and the Risk Register.

A4 -- a row with NO decision_state is excluded. RBD-2026-101 is on the register but carries no policy position, so it must not appear here; asserting the array holds exactly the two that do is what proves the filter is real rather than incidental.
